prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write strict TypeScript module solution.ts and export the named function.
Required API: export function multisetOverlap(left: readonly number[], right: readonly number[]): number[]
Behavior: Treat right as a multiset. Scan left in order and retain each value only while an unused equal occurrence remains in right. Preserve left order, do not mutate either input, and return a non-null empty result when there is no overlap.
Visible example: For left [3,1,3,2,3] and right [3,3,2], return [3,3,2].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

known_bad.code: export function multisetOverlap(left: readonly number[],right: readonly number[]): number[]{const s=new Set(right);return left.filter(x=>s.has(x))}
known_bad.label: set-instead-of-multiset

reference.code: export function multisetOverlap(left: readonly number[],right: readonly number[]): number[]{const c=new Map<number,number>();for(const x of right)c.set(x,(c.get(x)??0)+1);const out:number[]=[];for(const x of left){const n=c.get(x)??0;if(n>0){out.push(x);c.set(x,n-1)}}return out}
reference.label: author-reference
